title: Plugins
subtitle: Local plugins shipped with mimo2codex, plus community-contributed adapters.
enableHint: Enable it in the mimo2codex admin console → Plugins, then click "Install dependencies".

contribute.title: Contribute a fun plugin adapter
contribute.desc: Built an interesting computer-use / MCP plugin adapter? Submit it under Ideas — once accepted it shows up here and in the mimo2codex admin plugin marketplace.
